title: 飛行模擬器運動平台
summary: 以「用有限行程、頻率與視景同步理解模擬器運動提示」為主線，在非載人運動平台與視景時間線模型中依序完成有限行程與移動速度、傳動與力矩交換、振動衰減與舒適提示、視景及運動指令同步、洗出後的平順回復及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Understand simulator cues through finite stroke, frequency and visual synchronization in a Unoccupied platform and visual-timeline model, progressing through Finite stroke and movement speed, Transmission and torque exchange, Decay and comfortable cues, Visual-motion command synchronization, Smooth return after washout, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 有限行程與移動速度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Finite stroke and movement speed: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有限行程與移動速度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Finite stroke and movement speed and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛行模擬器運動平台」中，本單元處理「有限行程與移動速度」。運動平台以有限行程提供加速度提示，不能長時間複製真實位移；速度只是可行性的一項。
steps.instructionEn: Within Flight-simulator motion platforms, this unit examines Finite stroke and movement speed. Finite-stroke platforms cue acceleration rather than reproducing unlimited displacement; speed is only one feasibility factor.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：行程變化Δx=0.12 m、時間Δt=0.6 s。關係式 vavg=Δx/Δt；含輸出單位換算的算式 0.12/0.6，結果 0.2 m/s。適用範圍：平均直線速度，不含平台逆運動學、加速度及真實駕駛訓練合格性。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Stroke change dx=0.12 m over dt=0.6 s. Relation vavg=Δx/Δt; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 0.12/0.6 gives 0.2 m/s. Applicability: Mean linear speed excluding inverse kinematics, acceleration and training qualification.
steps.failure: 在「有限行程與移動速度」的情境中，視景持續前進但平台到行程端點時，需要平順回中而非突然反向。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Finite stroke and movement speed, Continuous visual motion with a saturated platform needs smooth recentering rather than sudden reversal.
steps.check: 針對「有限行程與移動速度」，將平台行程、視景位移和前庭提示分成不同曲線，說明洗出需求。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Finite stroke and movement speed, Plot platform stroke, visual travel and vestibular cue separately and explain washout. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 Δt 改為0.4 s，其餘條件固定。用 0.12/0.4 重算，結果從 0.2 變成 0.3 m/s。先預測方向，再記下對「有限行程與移動速度」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only dt to0.4 s, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 0.12/0.4: 0.2 becomes 0.3 m/s. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Finite stroke and movement speed, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

steps.titleEn: Platform actuator work: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 平台致動器作功 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Platform actuator work and its observable causal relationships.
